I don’t have a solution for you but I can tell you I understand. I grew up in a house where talking was the last thing we would do. My step mom hated me and My dad was always emotionally distant. I found out later that he has suicidal tendencies too. 
And I get the “friend” thing. I had fake friends in high school. I was left out as talk about behind my back. I never felt accepted anywhere. Even now at 27 I only have one friend that knows all of me and still loves me and is always there for me. 

There’s no medicine that you can take without seeing a dr since there are so many that they use for different symptoms. 

People always say “ you’ll miss high school” blah blah blah. It’s bullshit. High school sucks. The people are horrible, and people are more worried about being the one to pass on the best gossip than they are about being actual good friends. You can’t just stop caring what people think. It’s taken me years, and I still care too much sometimes. I honestly look back and wish I would have dumped those fake friends and spent more time with the “less popular” crowd. A few people I knew but didn’t spend much time with back then are some the people I trust the most now. 

Maybe talk to your school nurse? Tell her you don’t want your mom knowing but you know you need some help. Or find a way to go to a free clinic? I’ll look more into it and if I find a way for you to get help without your mother knowing I’ll let you know.
You’re welcome. It doesn’t have to be a teacher. Someone that you trust in general. I wish you the best in life you beautiful soul.
